claims.content: Customer
The Consumer Protection negative file must be cross-referenced before a new customer account can be successfully established to prevent undesirable customers from opening new accounts.
A site user (customer) requests to create an account to place bids.

trigger.raw_text: A site user (customer) requests to create an account to place bids.

claims.content: The customer navigates to the registration page (Registration Page 1) from the site.
The system displays a welcome message and form fields for First Name, Last Name, Email Address (entered twice), Password (8-12 characters, entered twice), and Member ID (Handle).
The customer enters the required user information.
The customer selects a default payment method (Credit card, PayPal, or Amazon Payments) and enters corresponding details if Credit Card is chosen.
The customer checks a checkbox to accept and agree with the JTVauctions.com Terms of Use Agreement.

The customer chooses an option: either click 'finish now' to proceed to Registration Page 2 for additional shipping/email info, or click 'browse now' to complete the short registration and proceed to sign-in/home page.
Upon completion, the system triggers an automated transactional email with a Thank You message and instructions to enable cookies/whitelist the email address.
If the customer clicks 'browse now', the system completes the short registration process and directs the user to the sign-in/home page, triggering the automated transactional email.

If the customer's information matches the Consumer Protection negative file during the cross-reference check, the system prevents the account from being established and displays a message stating: 'We are sorry, we are unable to create an auction account for you at this time. If you believe this message to be in error, please contact our Customer Service team at: 800-550-8393.'

If the customer's information matches the Consumer Protection negative file during cross-reference, the system prevents account creation and displays: 'We are sorry, we are unable to create an auction account for you at this time. If you believe this message to be in error, please contact our Customer Service team at: 800-550-8393.'

If a registrant tries to create a new account using an existing email address, the system generates a response notifying them that the email address is already in use and asks if they need to reset the password for that account.
A new customer account is successfully established in the system after passing all validation checks including Consumer Protection negative file cross-reference.

An automated transactional email is triggered upon completion of registration, containing a Thank You message and instructions to enable cookies and add JTV email addresses to the user’s whitelist or Safe Senders list.

If the customer selects 'browse now', they are directed to the sign-in/home page after short registration; if they select 'finish now', they proceed to Registration Page 2 for additional shipping and email preference information.
No two accounts may use the same email address; attempting to register with an existing email triggers a system response notifying the user and offering password reset.
The system prevents account creation if the registrant matches the Consumer Protection negative file, displaying an error message with Customer Service contact information.
